- [RARC.6.1.2] **Upward fact flow within one process** is integrator code.
  The lower engine hands the fact to the integrator through a callback, and
  the integrator asserts it into the upper engine: from inside that callback
  if it chooses, since that enters a different engine ([RARC.13.16]), or
  after the lower engine's call has returned.
